subject: orchid-mantis figurine
art_direction: 兰花花瓣与短足昆虫融合成鞠躬小角色，前肢像合拢花苞，柔紫绿配色。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Sculpt an orchid-inspired insect character in satin porcelain. Its body is a compact pale-lilac flower cup, with two broad side petals and short rounded green legs. The front limbs fold together like a closed bud in a small polite bow; do not use sharp mantis claws. Place a tiny attentive face inside the central petal. Use a desaturated teal studio background, soft glaze pooling at the joins, and a restrained contact shadow. Keep the silhouette calm and flower-like, avoiding realistic insect anatomy, predatory gestures, or a dense garden setting. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
